newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Asia Motors to build Brazil car plant.
newsitem.headline: Asia Motors to build Brazil car plant.

text.p: Asia Motors Co Ltd said it would invest $500 million in a new car factory in Brazil, its first manufacturing investment outside of South Korea, a company spokeswoman said.
The plant will produce 60,000 vehicles a year starting 1999, 60 percent of them the company's Towner model, and the rest its Topic car, the spokeswoman told Reuters.

The plant will be located in Camacari, Bahia state, one of several states due to benefit from incentives for auto producers based in the country's northeast under the terms of controversial presidential decree issued last week.
The decree offers manufacturers tax breaks and import tariff reductions.
The spokeswoman said Asia Motors had been waiting for the decree to be published before announcing its decision to invest in Brazil. She said the plant would directly create 2,500 jobs.
